mario64.title: Super Mario 64
mario64.evidence: First playable field after the course label. Follow Mario during grounded travel and a jump relative to the screen midpoint. Intro letter and dialogue are excluded from the opening.

trackmania.title: Trackmania
trackmania.evidence: Third-person car remains stable in the frame through direction changes, with the inside and outside of the course visible. First restart falls outside the working cut.

kirby.title: Kirby Air Ride · Fantasy Meadows
kirby.evidence: Air Ride sequence with normal travel followed by a visibly tilted and off-center machine. Use in-game tutorial cues only to establish the mechanic, then the race window for the effect.

rayman.title: Rayman Legends
rayman.evidence: Side-scrolling stretch with Rayman left of center and the next enemy and landing floor visible to the right. Use the continuous field stretch rather than doors or instruction popups.

armoredCore.decision: Retain the off-center evasion purpose in the teaching order. Only include a new capture if both reuse and before/action/result match are checked; otherwise draw the case with an independent camera and projectile model.
